nodes.name: onboard.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /onboard action: principles (show don't tell, time to value, optional flows) and patterns for welcome screens, account setup, empty states, tooltips, feature announcements, and guided tours.

nodes.name: optimize.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /optimize action covering frontend performance: image, bundle, CSS, and font loading; rendering and layout-thrash avoidance; GPU-accelerated animation; and React-specific optimizations.

nodes.name: overdrive.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /overdrive action: defining what 'extraordinary' means per surface type, a toolkit of cinematic transitions, scroll-tied animation, WebGL/canvas rendering, and a progressive-enhancement discipline.

nodes.name: polish.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /polish action: a systematic final-pass checklist spanning alignment, typography, color contrast, interaction states, micro-interactions, copy, forms, edge cases, responsiveness, and code quality.

nodes.name: product.md
nodes.summary: Defines the 'product' design register used for the authenticated dashboard: slop test, typography, color, layout, component, and motion rules plus product-specific bans and permissions.

nodes.name: quieter.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /quieter action: refining a design toward restraint via color desaturation, visual weight reduction, simplification, and motion reduction without collapsing into generic.

nodes.name: shape.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /shape action: a code-free discovery interview (purpose, content, direction, scope, constraints, anti-goals), optional visual-direction probes, and the design brief structure handed to /craft.

nodes.name: typeset.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the /typeset action: font selection, hierarchy, readability, and detail refinement, with an appendix on vertical rhythm, modular scale, measure, and live-mode signature params.
